description: Java class implementing a Google Cloud Pub/Sub publisher node for Thingsboard rule engine, handling message publishing, callback processing, and client initialization.

classes.name: TbPubSubNode
classes.description: Java class implementing a Google Cloud Pub/Sub publisher node for Thingsboard rule engine, handling message publishing, callback processing, and client initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, sets up PubSub client with credentials and retry settings.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, acknowledges if needed, and triggers message publishing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the PubSub client gracefully.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Builds and publishes a PubSub message, sets up callback for success or failure.

methods.name: processPublishResult
methods.description: Adds messageId to message metadata upon successful publish.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Adds error details to message metadata upon publish failure.

methods.name: initPubSubClient
methods.description: Creates and configures the PubSub Publisher client with credentials and retry settings.
